strings.크리시엔, 오늘도 졸려 보이네요. 하암…. 이 하품도 왠지 전염된 것 같: You look sleepy again today, Crisien. Yawn... I think your yawning is contagious.
I wanted to visit Phobos again.
strings.혹시 저한테 수선을 맡기거나 의뢰하고 싶은 옷이 있으신 건 아닌가요?: Do you have any clothes you'd like repaired, or something you'd like me to make?
strings.아쉽지만 어쩔 수 없죠…. 하암…. 그래도 저한테 오셨으니 그냥 가실 순: That's a shame, but it can't be helped... Yawn... Still, since you've come to see me, I can't let you leave just yet.
strings.발드릭 일로 부탁할 게 있어요?: Do you need a favor involving Valdrick?
strings.발드릭 아저씨가 붉은 곰처럼 거하게 드시고 주무시고 계실 거예요. 동면하: He's probably eaten an enormous meal and gone to sleep like a red bear. As if he's hibernating!
strings.잠깐, 잠자는 곰을 깨워야 할 정도의 부탁인가요?!: Wait, is this a favor worth waking a sleeping bear for?!
Whoa, it's nothing serious. No need to be scared.
He's the sort of person who greets you with a lethal attack...
strings.다 방법이 있어요. 깨우기 전에 피오니아 언니가 고기 준비했다고 그러면: There's a trick to it. Before you wake him, tell him Peonia has meat ready.
strings.셔츠 몇 벌 드렸는데, 얼마 안 지나서 엉망이 되더라구요. 그래서 이제는: I gave him a few shirts, but they were ruined in no time. I've given up and just repair what he's wearing now and then.
strings.아저씨 옷 수선한지 오래 됐으니까 마르스에 와서 수선을 받으시라고 하면: It's been a while since I last mended his clothes. Tell him to come to Mars for repairs.
Tell him I'll come out if he shouts, "Miss Designer!" outside.
It's embarrassing to say, but my dream is to become a famous fashion designer. I'm studying to make that happen.
strings.프레이오스 대륙에는 그런 디자이너들이 많다고 들었어요. 기회가 되면 한: I've heard there are many designers like that in Freios. I'd love to visit if I get the chance.
You'll do well. Don't worry too much. When you make it, I'll be your customer.
You've cheered me up, %s, so I'll go take a little nap.
strings.어우, 나도 졸립네. 그럼 발드릭에게 가볼까?: Oh, now I'm sleepy too. Shall I go see Valdrick?
strings.(발드릭이 한적한 장소에서 자리를 잡은 채, 자유로운 몸짓을 하며 잠들어: (Valdrick sleeps sprawled comfortably in a quiet spot. Empty dishes surround him, suggesting he recently finished eating.)
strings.진짜 겨울잠 준비하는 붉은 곰이네…. 그런데 발드릭을 깨워야 하나, 말: He really is a red bear preparing to hibernate... Should I wake him or not...?
Then, like Crisien said... Valdrick, Peonia has meat...
Meat sounds good. It's roasted, right? Soup doesn't count.
It worked. He got right up.
Crisien said you'd wake up immediately if I said that.
Oh, well. She'll just have to treat me to a feast next time...
strings.네가 온 걸 보면 크리시엔이 마르스 앞에서 또 디자이너 선생님이라고 불러: Since she sent you, I suppose Crisien wants me to call her "Miss Designer" outside Mars again?
strings.옷 수선 귀찮은데…. 그렇다고 엉망인 옷을 계속 입고 다닐 수는 없으니까: Getting clothes repaired is a bother... But I can't keep wearing them in tatters.
Hanging heavy things from cloth probably doesn't help.
True. But it can't be helped. I have to stay alive.
strings.초인이라 불리는 나도 기본적으론 사람이야. 그러니까 살아야지. 이 귀찮은: I may be called a Champion, but I'm still human at heart. I have to live. If I die, someone else will inherit this troublesome power.
strings.가져가는 사람이 무슨 짓을 할 줄 알고 내가 어떻게 죽어. 내 거니까 내: How could I die when I don't know what that person would do with it? It's mine, so I have to look after it.
strings.어, 내가 이야기 안 했었나? 전혀 모르겠다는 표정인 걸 보니 다른 녀석: Oh, hadn't I told you? You look completely lost. The others must not have explained.
I simply thought you'd received power from a god.
strings.그래? 아드키나 할아범은 용이니까 빼고 인간인 지스카드 아우님, 샤이닉: Really? Leaving old Atkina aside since he's a dragon, the humans—my little brother Ziskad, that brat Shynic, and the ladies Medea and Io...
strings.다들 죽지 못해 사는 거야. 죽을 때를 놓친 거고. 이렇게라도 살지 않으: We're all living because we can't die. We missed our time to go. If we didn't find ways to live like this, we'd go mad.
strings.꼬맹이가 옷을 수선해준댔으니 언제 한번 가야겠어. 소원대로 디자이너 선생: Since the kid offered to mend my clothes, I'll have to visit sometime. She'll be happy if I call her "Miss Designer" like she wants, right?
strings.그나저나 꼬맹이는 괜찮을까? 나 때문에 마을에서 따돌림이나 당하지 않으면: I wonder if she's all right, though. I hope the village isn't shunning her because of me...
strings.피오니아나 꼬맹이도 먹고살기 힘든데, 내 밥도 챙겨주잖아. 얼마나 고마워: Peonia and the kid both struggle to get by, yet they still feed me. How could I not be grateful?
strings.역시 배를 채울 땐 고기지. 꼬맹이는 고기보다 옷을 더 좋아해서 신기하다: Nothing fills your stomach like meat. Funny how the kid likes clothes more than meat. Oh, that reminds me!
Little sibling, if you're bored, do me a favor.
strings.요람에서 하얀 꽃을 잔뜩 구해와. 나는 다 똑같아 보여서 아우님이 구해오: Bring me lots of white flowers from the Cradle. They all look the same to me. If you gather them, maybe you'll find the right ones.
Yep. Now I'm going to sleep.
strings.잘 거라고, 아우님이 내 잠을 방해했잖아. 지스카드 아우님에게 들었지?: I'm going to sleep. You interrupted my nap. You heard from little brother Ziskad, didn't you? Think you could spar with me for three days and nights without a break?
If I don't wake up, say "meat." Actual meat would be even better.
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 발드릭이 자리에 누워 잠이 든다.): (The instant he finishes speaking, Valdrick lies down and falls asleep.)
strings.(후아, 빨리 다녀와서 뭘 좀 먹어야겠다. 고기?): (Whew. I'll hurry back and get something to eat. Meat, maybe?)
strings.(발드릭이 웅크린 채로 자고 있다. 분명 잠들어 있지만, 강한 기운이 느: (Valdrick sleeps curled up. Even asleep, he radiates a powerful presence.)
strings.(다른 초인들에 비해서 야생적인 느낌이야.): (He feels wilder than the other Champions.)
Valdrick, I'm back. Right, he said that wouldn't wake him.
strings.고기 대신 꽃은 가져왔어?: Did you bring flowers instead of meat?
strings.발드릭, 이건 어디에 쓰려고 가져오라고 한 거예요?: Valdrick, what do you need these for?
strings.이 꽃은 물건에 깃든 악마의 기운을 빼는데 사용해. 스승이 날 처음 보자: These flowers draw demonic energy out of objects. When my master first met me, she called me a devil and slapped me with them.
strings.예시가 전혀 다르지 않아요?: Isn't that a completely different example?
Hahaha! A devil like me turned out this well. Same difference.
strings.어디 보자♬ 스승이 예전에 꽃잎을 다 떼서 몸에 지닌다고 하면 다 된 거: Let's see♬ Master said to pull off all the petals and carry them with you. That's all it takes♬
Why are you giving these to me...?
Now, tuck them inside your clothes and go back into the Cradle.
strings.가서 릴리스라는 몽마가 남긴 드레스를 찾아줘. 고위 몽마들은 외출시 여벌: Find a dress that succubus Lilith left behind. I've heard high-ranking succubi bring spare clothes when they go out.
strings.아마도 릴리스라면 꽤 고급품을 가져왔을 거야. 이번에도 너라면 발견할 수: Lilith probably brought something quite luxurious. I'm sure you'll be able to find it again.
strings.발견하는 대로 나한테 오지 말고, 바로 크리시엔에게 가져다 줘. 그 녀석: Once you find it, take it straight to Crisien instead of coming back to me. It'll help with her studies. Tell her it's in return for the meat.
strings.그래도 악마의 옷인데, 가져다 줘도 괜찮을까요?: But it's a demon's dress. Is it really safe to give her?
Don't worry so much, little sibling. These are no ordinary flowers.
strings.스승이 세상을 떴을 때, 아드키나 할아범이 애도하기 위해 라피어에서 가져: When my master passed away, old Atkina brought them from Lapier to mourn her. They bloomed, withered, bloomed again, and spread...
strings.시간이 꽤 오래 지났어도 여전히 효과 만점인 꽃이지. 아는 사람은 얼마: Even after all this time, they work perfectly. Few people know that, though. Hahaha.
I asked for your help, but I feel bad. It seems like I'm taking advantage of you.
It's fine. As long as it isn't sparring.
That hurts a little... Anyway, I'm counting on you. I'll get some more sleep.
Rest well, then. See you later.
strings.(발드릭이 환의 요람으로 가는 %s의 뒷모습을 보고는 바닥에 눕는다.): (Watching %s head toward the Cradle of Illusions, Valdrick lies down on the ground.)
Is it about time everyone arrived? I'll get up when they wake me.
strings.(크리시엔이 옷감을 든 채로 꾸벅꾸벅 졸고 있다.): (Crisien nods off while holding a piece of fabric.)
strings.(신기하네. 처음 발견했을 땐 서큐버스 느낌이 들었는데, 지금은 꽃잎 때: (Strange. When I first found it, it felt like a succubus's dress. Now, thanks to the petals, it almost feels sacred.)
strings.흐아아암…. 졸려. %s? 발드릭 아저씨에게 간 거 아니었어요?: Yaaawn... So sleepy. %s? Weren't you going to see Uncle Valdrick?
I did. I have something for you.
strings.(항상 졸린 눈을 하던 크리시엔의 눈매가 또렷해진다.): (Crisien's perpetually sleepy eyes snap wide open.)
strings.이건 뭔가요? 오래전 멸망한 하울 왕국에만 전해지는 방법으로 얻을 수 있: What is this? The finest velvet, made using a technique said to have been passed down only in the long-fallen Kingdom of Howl!!
strings.입는 사람의 매력을 극대화시켜주는 초감각적인 디자인!!: An exquisite design that brings out the wearer's charm to the fullest!!
And such a lovely rose fragrance! Incredibly elegant and beautiful...
strings.이거 원래 이스트랜드에 없던 거죠? 이 정도로 좋은 게 갑자기 생겼다는: This didn't originally come from Eastland, did it? Something this wonderful suddenly appearing...
strings.네, 뭐…. 자세하게 알려드리긴 애매한데, 괜찮은 거예요. 여신님의 힘으: Well, yes... It's difficult to explain exactly, but it's safe. I found it with the goddess's power.
Valdrick said it's in return for the meat.
Ah... The amount of meat that man has eaten...
Just how much does he eat...?
strings.헤헤, 말이 그렇다는 거죠. 그러면 잘 받을게요. 마침 새로 참고할 만한: Hehe, I'm only saying. I'll gladly accept it. I was looking for a new outfit to study. Hehe...
Thanks to you both, I'm a little closer to my dream.
strings.아, 모험가님. 물어보고 싶은 게 있어요. 혹시 여성 초인을 만나신 적이: Oh, Adventurer. There's something I wanted to ask. Have you ever met any female Champions?
strings.멋진 분들이라고 들었거든요. 그분들에게 제 옷을 드리고 패션쇼에 서게 하: I've heard they're wonderful. I'd like to give them my clothes and have them walk in a fashion show.
The three of them have different figures and styles, so I'd like to design something for each of them. Hehe. One might be easier than the others.
Uncle Valdrick said she's a little brat like me.
You'll get in trouble if you say that to her face...
Good luck, Crisien. I'll be cheering you on.
Thank you, Adventurer! Come visit Mars often.
strings.후후후…. 그럼 피오 언니한테 먼저 입혀볼까. 언니는 뭐든 잘 어울리니까: Hehehe... Maybe I'll have Peo try it on first. Everything suits her.
